lineItems.name: Storage Bins
lineItems.itemDescription:
Heavy-duty, storage bin designed for use in feed, grain, biomass, and in-
gredient processing environments. The unit includes a fully welded up-
per wall assembly, converging lower hopper section, access door with
viewing window, and reinforced leg structure for stable floor mounting.
Approximate Overall Dimensions:
Height: ~245 in (20.4 ft)
Width: ~120 in
Depth: ~120 in
Standard Features:
- 1/4″ A36 mild steel hopper
- 12 ga A36 mild steel upper side wall
- Reinforced structural frame and legs
- Plexiglass Indicator Panel
- 2x Access doors for inspection
- Top cover
- Suitable for dry bulk materials

lineItems.name: XF-19 Fan
lineItems.itemDescription:
Exhaust Fan
• XF-19 Fan
• Arrangement #9F heavy-gauge steel base with continuous welds.
• Heavy-duty pillow block bearings.
• Turned, ground, and straightened shaft.
• Dynamically and statically balanced rotor with tapered hub and bush-
ing.
• Narrow width high static, heavy-duty rotor.
• Rotor to be fabricated of AR 235 Plate Steel.
• Heavy duty housing with continuous welds.
• Housing to be fabricated of carbon steel.
• Motor slide base with integral drive tensioning mechanism.
• 10 HP, 1800 RPM, class TEFC, 230-460V/3/60 NEMA Premium efficient
motor.
• NOTE: TEFC motor with no environmental marking/T Code.
• V-belt drive with 1.5 to 2.0 service factor.
• Totally enclosed sanitary belt and shaft guard.
• Factory test run prior to shipment.
• Inlet to 11" OD.
• Flanged rectangular outlet.
• Housing to have a drain port in the bottom.
• Product contact zones unpainted, all other surfaces painted Basalt
Gray; guards painted safety orange. Please specify otherwise.
